name: Xi'an Xice Testing Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Xi'an Xice Testing Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides inspection and testing services in China. The company offers environmental and reliability testing, electronic components testing and screening, and electromagnetic compatibility testing. It also engages in the research, development, production, and sale of testing equipment; electronic assembly services; technology services; loading, unloading, and warehousing; and wholesale and retail trade. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Xi'an, China.
